articles.summary: Newsmax2 now airs on 112 HC2 broadcast stations nationwide, including stations in all of the top 40 U.S. television markets BOCA RATON, FL AND NEW YORK, NY / ACCESS Newswire / November 18, 2026 / Newsmax Inc. (NYSE:NMAX) ("Newsmax"), through its subsidiary Newsmax Broadcasting LLC, and HC2 Broadcasting ("HC2"), the largest operator of Class A and low-power television (LPTV) stations in the United States, today announced that Newsmax2, Newsmax's free streaming channel, is now broadcasting over the air across 112 HC2-owned television stations under an agreement between the two companies. Newsmax2 began airing on the HC2 stations on November 5. The agreement has significantly widened Newsmax2's broadcast footprint, making the 24/7 news and commentary network available free over the air in all of the top 40 U.S. television markets and 57 of the top 60 markets nationwide. Grew total social media followers 13% year-over-year to 26.8 million as of September 30, 2026, further strengthening the Company's multi-platform audience ecosystem.
